_about: Synthetic, never captured: no festival was live in production when it was captured on 2026-10-19, and opening one is user-visible. What source commit f6d95889 answered (its src/map is production commit 5c0ee5a9's) over a real mongod with the eskara-2026 layer set, its activation open from 2026-10-01T00:00+09:00 to 2026-10-03T06:00+09:00, the 77 places of scripts/data/eskara-2026-places.json imported through scripts/lib/eventmap-db.js, and the clock at 2026-10-01T21:00+09:00: GET /map/config in ko, en and zh, GET /map/overlays/event and GET /map/overlays/event/details. Each entry is the status, the parsed body and the weak ETag. Nothing trimmed. The hssc_route layer was added to each /map/config body after jongro07_route on 2026-10-23, and its ETag recomputed from the new body, when the HSSC route line joined the transit overlays on purpose. On 2026-10-23 each /map/config body gained the tab lens on purpose (tabs on the building and route line layers, and the transit tab's shuttle_routes chip after inquiry), and its ETag was recomputed from the new body. On 2026-10-24 the shuttle_routes chip of each /map/config body gained the map tab and opensIn map on purpose (a chip runs where its result shows; app ADR 0022 D1), and its ETag was recomputed from the new body. On 2026-10-24 the building_code chip of each /map/config body gained an empty tabs on purpose (the shared-map shell's search field replaces it, so that shell lists it in no tab), and its ETag was recomputed from the new body.
